gcp.monitoring.read_time_series.note: Monitoring read API calls: per time series returned, at least one per call; calls from the console (not Cloud Shell) and write calls are free. The first million a billing account a month are free and ignored. Synced from the Billing Catalog.

gcp.monitoring.volume_tier1.note: Metric volume charged by bytes ingested, 150 to 100,000 MiB a billing account; the first 150 MiB are free and ignored, and the tier bounds are applied to one metric. Synced from the Billing Catalog.

gcp.monitoring.volume_tier2.note: Metric volume charged by bytes ingested, 100,000 to 250,000 MiB a billing account. Synced from the Billing Catalog.

gcp.monitoring.volume_tier3.note: Metric volume charged by bytes ingested, over 250,000 MiB a billing account. Synced from the Billing Catalog.
